cases.case_label: Japanese founder retrotransposal insertion in FKTN (Korean patients)
cases.mechanism_detail: Two Korean patients were homozygous and seven heterozygous for the Japanese founder retrotransposal insertion in FKTN (five compound heterozygous with a pseudoexon-activating intronic variant). The element class and mechanism are not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: Two patients were homozygous for the Japanese founder retrotransposal insertion mutation.
